findings.content: validate-verdict accepts structurally invalid precise locations such as start_line=0/end_line=5 or end_line < start_line. The command tells external adapters to use it as the pre-finish validator, but CommandReviewAdapter later rejects the same ranges in _validated_comments_for_cell, so an adapter can see validation pass and still fail the review run. Mirror the adapter's basic line-range validation here for non-imprecise comments.
